planningTips.title: Springfield Calendar Planning Notes
content: Before school begins, confirm the start date and calendar for your child's grade, program, and assigned school.
Treat June 25 as tentative and avoid locking in nonrefundable summer plans until SPS issues its final bulletin.
The ICS is a one-time snapshot. Recheck SPS after weather closures or any calendar revision.

districtFaqs.q: Is this the Springfield Public Schools calendar for Massachusetts?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. This page covers Springfield Public Schools in Springfield, Massachusetts, using springfieldpublicschools.com and the official district calendar. The MA suffix distinguishes it from Springfield systems in Missouri and Illinois.

districtFaqs.q: What is the difference between schools closed and district closed?
districtFaqs.a: The PDF's yellow dates close schools for students and teachers, while green dates close schools and central offices. During some vacations, families may still be able to reach district offices on yellow dates.

districtFaqs.q: Do SEZP and Innovation schools use the same SPS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. SPS provides separate calendar collections for Springfield Empowerment Zone Partnership and Innovation schools. Families should compare the district PDF with the calendar named for their assigned school.

districtFaqs.q: Does the SPS calendar include every religious or cultural observance?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district calendar does not list every religious or cultural observance and directs families to the SPS Informational Calendar for a broader list of holidays and celebrations.
